scope: Five argparse verbs; package workflows; no scheduler backend

prepare.audit: All existing labels, masks, case identity, demand law, shard hashes and source partitions; inputs read-only

parity.threshold: Identical output dtype and bytes; seeded official/local test-ID intersection; IDs persisted before evaluation

restart.mechanism: Existing run(stop_after_steps=4090) through the CLI training dispatch, then ordinary train --resume
restart.gate: Exact checkpoint configuration, counters, optimizer, scheduler, model and RNG restore; unchanged committed journal and epoch order

evaluation.same_input_audit: P versus checked Ipopt on the same demand arrays; preserve unresolved cells as unavailable

reproducibility.justification: User-declared one-sided non-inferiority; improvements pass; no two-sided rejection on n=3
reproducibility.loss_curve: Diagnostic comparison at common persisted optimizer steps; no acceptance tolerance
reproducibility.near_zero: Loss diagnostic relative differences use denominator max(abs(reference),1e-12); gate uses the absolute 0.005 slack

regression.protocol: Unchanged Phase 2: 50-hour case30 audit, two-origin forward, and two recorded checkpoints on three origins each

tests.existing: 140 tests plus 3 subtests, no failures or skips

layouts: two-epoch training with boundary restart; continue from atomic checkpoint if required
evaluation/report/verification and unchanged Phase 2 model gates
stop_conditions: No merge after a failed scientific gate
No extra training beyond seed0 two epochs
No automatic training resubmission inside package
Stop at four allocations; preserve partial evidence
